entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I think I need to return something? I ordered a jersey, but it's just not right. The whole process is so confusing.

I can certainly look into that for you. I just need a little more information to understand the situation. What specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, um, a preference, I guess? I got the ProFit jersey, but I think I ordered the wrong size. It's just way too tight on me. I'm not sure if I need an exchange or a return. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. It sounds like you need to exchange it for a different size. Let me just pull up your order information. Can I get the order number, please?
Okay, hold on... It's VF78-291-B. I'm just so lost with these things. I got it a few weeks ago for Christmas but I was traveling.
No problem at all. I have your order right here. I see you purchased the ProFit Jersey, and it was delivered 26 days ago, on November 29th. Let me just check our policy for you.
Oh, is that too long? I hope it's okay.
Not at all! According to my system, VeloFit has a 90-day return window for standard items like this jersey. Since you're well within that timeframe, we can definitely process this for you.
Oh, that's such a relief! So I can send back this jersey that's too tight and get a new one?
Absolutely. I can initiate the exchange for the correct size right now, and I'll email you a prepaid return label for the original item. Would you like to go up one size?
Yes, please! Thank you so much, Sarah. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome. I've just processed the exchange. You should see the return label in your email inbox within the next 15 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. Thank you again!
